name: read_partition_conjecture
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import pathlib,subprocess,sys,re
p=pathlib.Path.cwd();z=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout',str(p/'sources/partition-original.pdf'),'-'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30);assert z.returncode==0
w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'sources/partition-original.txt'],input=z.stdout,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=10);assert w.returncode==0
s=z.stdout
for m in re.finditer('Conjecture',s):print(s[max(0,m.start()-1000):m.start()+3800])
s=(p/'sources/craig.txt').read_text();print('CRAIG_PROOF',s[s.index('4. Proof'):s.index('4. Proof')+4000] if '4. Proof' in s else s[-12500:])
